description: A minecart launched east by powered rails carrying a villager (still) past the player, who stands on a block beside the rail, looking at it: the villager's box pushes the player and takes the crosshair, the minecart's doesn't reach; then one carrying a spider (sitting lower on a cart no wider than itself, too low to reach the player) with a wither skeleton on it, which pushes the player and takes the crosshair.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
